Could you design a system architecture diagram in SVG and provide a React component for the user profile card?

Thinking Process: 1. Need to generate clean, self-contained SVG vectors for the distributed system architecture. 2. Structure the React component using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. 3. Ensure modularity and accessible color contrast.

Here is the architectural overview along with the production-ready React component.

System Architecture Diagram (SVG)
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect width="400" height="200" rx="10" fill="#1e293b"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="40" fill="#3b82f6"/>
  <text x="100" y="105" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ffffff" font-size="14">Client</text>
  <line x1="140" y1="100" x2="260" y2="100" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="100" r="40" fill="#10b981"/>
  <text x="300" y="105" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ffffff" font-size="14">Server</text>
</svg>
UserProfileCard.tsx (React)
import React from 'react';

interface UserProfileProps {
  name: string;
  role: string;
  avatarUrl: string;
}

export const UserProfileCard: React.FC<UserProfileProps> = ({ name, role, avatarUrl }) => {
  return (
    <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md flex items-center space-x-4">
      <img className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full" src={avatarUrl} alt={name} />
      <div>
        <div className="text-xl font-medium text-black">{name}</div>
        <p className="text-gray-500">{role}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

Both artifacts are ready for deployment into your component library.
